blocks.card.credential: Marriage and Family Therapy Life Coach
blocks.card.summary: Women and older teens working through shame, anxiety, and grief.
blocks.hero.subhead: Helps women and older teens who feel stuck in shame, anxiety, or defeat see themselves through truth, feel safe in their story, and take steps toward peace and healing.
blocks.quote: You don't have to have it all figured out to start. You just need a safe place to tell the truth about your story.

sections.heading: Who Rhonda works with
sections.body: Rhonda works with older teens, young adults, and women of every age, many of whom are struggling to know their value and worth. They may be walking through grief, a life transition, anxiety, guilt, or shame, often after years of a way of coping that no longer works.

sections.heading: Rhonda's approach
sections.body: Rhonda is trained as a marriage and family therapist and also serves as a life coach. Her style is relational and straightforward. She listens carefully and helps you notice the lens you've been seeing your life through. She sees healing as something you build together.

blocks.practical.body: In person in Middletown or online. Usually seen the same week.
blocks.faith.heading: Faith
blocks.faith.body: For women who want Christian integration, Rhonda helps explore the difference between religion and relationship, and whether false beliefs about God or about yourself may be shaping the pain. If you'd rather not bring faith in, she follows your lead.
blocks.request.heading: Ready to start with Rhonda?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment with Rhonda, or call (502) 523-2970.
blocks.hero.eyebrow: Shame, anxiety, grief, identity and worth
